summary: Failed Pierre highlighter chunks leave Markdown and diff code plain for the session, without retry or reload controls. Conversation and terminal chunk recovery is unchanged.

schema.detail: No stored or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Highlighting remains deferred until after plain-code first paint. Failure is sticky within the current document; other lazy chunks keep their independent recovery state.

downtime.detail: Takes effect in the next web build; no daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action. Highlighting failures do not offer or trigger a page reload.

recovery.detail: Revert this change and rebuild the web application.
